Name: Natural Paths Plus 1.6
Author: TylerBits
Description:
[size=5][b]Natural Paths Plus 1.6[/b][/size]

This mod adds 4 fully functional, seamless custom paths to Stardew Valley: [b]Dirt, Grass, Forest Grass (Dark), and Dense Grass (Darkest).[/b]

Built from the ground up for 1.6, it goes beyond just adding textures by integrating advanced quality-of-life mechanics like block-swapping, tool protection, and deterministic texture variations.
[size=4]
✨  Key Features[/size]

[list]
[*][b]Adaptive Autotiling:[/b] Unlike older methods that rely on simple transparent edges, this mod uses true engine-level autotiling. Paths dynamically adapt their borders, corners, and transition states based on neighboring path tiers (e.g., Darkest Grass seamlessly blends into Dark Grass with custom-authored transition art). [/*]
[*][b]Terraria-Style Block Swapping: [/b]Place a new path directly over an old one to instantly swap it. No need to break the old path first.[/*]
[*][b]Underlay Support:[/b] Works perfectly under trees, grass starters, and debris.[/*]
[*][b]Path Variations: [/b]Paths naturally spawn variations (flowers, pebbles, rocks). These are tied to the tile coordinates, meaning they look organic but won't flicker or change every time you load your save.[/*]
[*][b]Compatible with map recolors[/b] (DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor, Vibrant Pastoral, Starblue, etc.).
  [/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/size]

Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can change these settings in-game:
[list]
[*][b]Path Speed Bonus: [/b]Adjust the movement speed multiplier when walking on these paths.[/*]
[*][b]Texture Variation Level:[/b] A slider (0-3) to control how often flowers and pebbles spawn on the paths (0% to 30% chance).[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Mechanics:[/b] Enable or disable Path Swapping, Tool Protection, and Grass Spread.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. 
3. (Optional but recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
4. Download this mod and extract the `.zip` file into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b][size=4]⚠️ Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Works natively with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/b][/*]
[*]Safe to add or remove mid-save. If you remove the mod, the custom paths will safely disappear from your farm without crashing.[/*]
[*][b]Compatible with map recolors[/b] (DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor, Vibrant Pastoral, Starblue, etc.).[/*]
[/list]
